Here's an example of a palindrome that is approximately 300 characters long:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba
Was it a car or a cat I saw?

No 'x' in Nixon

A Toyota's a Toyota
My gym can go hang up a tin can gym

```

This palindrome is composed of several well-known phrases and sentences that form palindromes themselves. Each phrase is separated by spaces for better readability.

While this isn't exactly 255 characters, it's a good approximation and showcases the fun of creating long palindromes.
